All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
Proton AG issues only.
PaperCut MF, PaperCut NG, PaperCut Hive, PaperCut Pocket, PaperCut Mobility Print, QRdoc, PaperCut Views, PaperCut Multiverse, https://www.papercut.com, and all other PaperCut products and services.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Vestel-owned brands and products only.
Roche’s medical technology products.

Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by Patchstack and Patchstack Bug Bounty program unless covered by the scope of another CNA.

Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
Vulnerabilities identified in Cribl products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Cribl that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All Cisco products, and any third-party research targets that are not in another CNA’s scope. Cisco will not issue a CVE ID for issues reported on products that are past the Last Day of Support milestone, as defined on Cisco’s End-of-Life Policy, which is available at https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/eos-eol-policy.html.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.
Foxit issues only.
QNAP issues only.
All NLnet Labs projects.
Vulnerabilities in software published and maintained by Progress Software Corporation.
All Esri products only, including ArcGIS.
All HCL products only.
Tenable products and third-party products it researches not covered by another CNA.

All projects hosted by the Eclipse Foundation as listed at https://www.eclipse.org/projects/ and services provided by the Eclipse Foundation to support open source projects as listed at https://www.eclipsestatus.io/.
Unisoc issues only.
ZTE products only.
AMD branded products and technologies only. AMD does not evaluate, remediate, or issue CVE IDs for vulnerabilities that only affect End-of-Life/End-of-Support products and technologies.
All products of Axis Communications AB including end-of-life/end-of-service products.

Only supported and end-of-life Django versions available at https://www.djangoproject.com/download/ and projects listed at https://github.com/django (such as Django, channels, and daphne), excluding distributions maintained by third-party redistributors.
Check Point Security Gateways product line only, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Check Point that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Kaspersky B2C and B2B products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered in third-party software not in another CNA’s scope.
All Honeywell products.
Eaton issues only.
VMware, Spring, and Cloud Foundry issues only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Provides CVE IDs for its customers as part of its bug bounty and vulnerability coordination platform.
All rami.io GmbH products and open source projects, including pretix, official pretix plugins and apps, and Venueless.
All vulnerabilities discovered in third-party hardware/software by SEC Consult Vulnerability Lab (part of SEC Consult, an Eviden business), which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Core Joomla! CMS, the Joomla Framework, and Joomla! Extensions issues only.
OPPO devices only.
Security issues and vulnerabilities in the GNU C Library.

Any code repository hosted under gerrit.wikimedia.org, gitlab.wikimedia.org, or github.com/wikimedia that is not labeled as archived or marked as a fork of an upstream project. Please see our disclosure policy for additional exclusions to scope.
All ServiceNow products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by ServiceNow that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All components from the systemd project, including systemd, udev, systemd-journald, systemd-resolved, systemd-boot, systemd-stub, mkosi, and other components maintained on https://github.com/systemd.
OpenSSL software projects only.
Oracle supported version product issues only; CVE IDs will not be assigned for unsupported products or versions (Oracle will confirm support status and notify researcher).
Huawei issues only.

Meta-supported open source projects, mobile apps, and other software, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Meta that are not in another CNA’s scope; see: https://www.facebook.com/whitehat and https://github.com/facebook/.
Symantec Enterprise products as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Symantec that are not in another CNA’s scope.
